parameters.query:
SELECT e.nombre AS estacion, m.parametro, m.valor, m.medido_en
FROM mediciones_aire m
JOIN estaciones e ON e.id = m.estacion_id
WHERE m.parametro = $1
  AND m.medido_en BETWEEN $2::date AND ($3::date + interval '1 day')
ORDER BY m.medido_en ASC
LIMIT 500;

parameters.query:
SELECT
  ROUND(AVG(valor)::numeric, 1) AS promedio,
  MAX(valor) AS maximo,
  MIN(valor) AS minimo,
  COUNT(*) AS cantidad
FROM mediciones_aire
WHERE parametro = $1
  AND medido_en BETWEEN $2::date AND ($3::date + interval '1 day');

parameters.query:
SELECT parametro, MIN(medido_en) AS desde_disponible, MAX(medido_en) AS hasta_disponible, COUNT(*) AS total
FROM mediciones_aire
WHERE parametro = $1
GROUP BY parametro;

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO rate_limit (ip, conteo, ventana_inicio)
VALUES ($1, 1, now())
ON CONFLICT (ip) DO UPDATE SET
  conteo = CASE
    WHEN rate_limit.ventana_inicio < now() - interval '1 minute' THEN 1
    ELSE rate_limit.conteo + 1
  END,
  ventana_inicio = CASE
    WHEN rate_limit.ventana_inicio < now() - interval '1 minute' THEN now()
    ELSE rate_limit.ventana_inicio
  END
RETURNING conteo;
